description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for MQTT publish tests in a Hono-based IoT platform. It includes test setup, message sending, message receiving, and validation logic to ensure MQTT messages are correctly published and consumed within the system.

classes.name: MqttPublishTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for MQTT publish integration tests, providing common setup, message handling, and validation logic to verify message publishing and consumption within the Hono MQTT adapter.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Abstract method to send a message on behalf of a device to the MQTT adapter.

methods.name: handlePublishAttempt
methods.description: Handles the outcome of an attempt to publish a message, managing timeouts and success/failure conditions.

methods.name: assertMessageReceivedRatio
methods.description: Verifies that the ratio of received to sent messages is acceptable based on QoS settings.

methods.name: getTimeToWait
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for waiting for received messages.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Abstract method to create a message consumer for the test.

methods.name: testUploadMessages
methods.description: Test case that verifies messaging throughput via standard topic names.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingShortTopicNames
methods.description: Test case that verifies messaging throughput via short topic names.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingClientCertificate
methods.description: Test case that verifies messaging throughput using client certificate authentication.

methods.name: doTestUploadMessages
methods.description: Helper method that performs the messaging upload test with message sending, receiving, and validation.

methods.name: customizeConnectedClient
methods.description: Hook to customize MQTT client behavior before publishing messages.

methods.name: assertMessageProperties
methods.description: Checks key properties of received MQTT messages.

methods.name: assertAdditionalMessageProperties
methods.description: Allows subclasses to perform further validation on received messages.
